title: The TCP acknowledgment number is the next expected sequence number
summary: A cumulative ACK of X acknowledges all sequence numbers before X as received in order. It does not acknowledge X itself.
applies: Packet capture and reconstruction; TCP sequence space
aliases: What to look forward to next
detail: Do not compare absolute sequence numbers across directions to infer order. Each direction has its own sequence space.
boundary: Delayed ACKs and retransmissions mean segments and ACKs need not correspond one to one.
relevance: Explain situations where the same ACK appears repeatedly in the packet capture timeline or when an ACK spans multiple segments at a time.
